anchor_value: First Lien Debt row with SOFR + 3.00%, interest rate 8.40%, maturity 9/20/2030

findings.detail: GTCR Investors LP - A-1 Units is stored as private equity, but the raw schedule places it under First Lien Debt with SOFR spread, stated interest rate, maturity, and par amount.
The preferred-equity rows with stated rates are source-supported equity rows, so X01 should not treat every private-equity interest_rate as a data defect.

rationale: Class 2 within-row review. Most flagged rates are legitimate source-stated rates on preferred equity under Equity headings, for example Guidehouse Preferred Equity at 11.50% and Lobos Preferred Shares at 10.50%. However, at least one flagged row is a real classification error: GTCR Investors LP - A-1 Units is under the filing's First Lien Debt section and carries SOFR + 3.00%, 8.40% interest, maturity 9/20/2030, and par amount, so storing it as PRIVATE_EQUITY caused a real X01 issue.
